question:
A trading desk must reconcile several signed position adjustments.
Their values are:
  adjustment_1 = 3
  adjustment_2 = 11
  adjustment_3 = -1221
The net exposure is the product of all the adjustments.
Compute the net exposure as an exact signed integer.

adjustment_1 = 3  
adjustment_2 = 11

First multiply adjustment_1 and adjustment_2:

3 × 11 = 33  

Now multiply by adjustment_3:

33 × (-1221) = - (33 × 1221)  

33 × 1221:  
1221 × 30 = 36630  
1221 × 3 = 3663  
Sum: 36630 + 3663 = 40293  

So the product is -40293.
